Class RunnerJarReader

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.runner.build.RunnerJarReader
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable
public final class RunnerJarReader extends Object implements Closeable
Opens a finished runner jar with the launcher's own reader.

This is deliberately thin. The index reader and the archive primitives live in the launcher and are shared with this module as source, so a test, the inspect tool and the verification pass at the end of a build all look at an archive through exactly the code that will read it at startup. A second reader written for build time would be a second set of bugs.

A reader holds a memory mapping and a file handle and must be closed. On Windows an open mapping keeps the file locked, so a build that forgets to close one cannot overwrite the archive it just wrote.

Since:
1.0
